name: Jingai Bishounen Ikumouzai
source:
Dr. Hair Growth, who lives in the woods due to a certain blunder, discovers a black-haired boy who is attacked by slime one day.
A doctor who takes a slime-stained boy to his bathroom and wash his hair with his own shampoo.

But the shampoo he picked up
It used to be a failed "human hair remover" that pushed itself to the bottom.

A doctor who rushes to the boy.
However, at that time, something terrible happened to the hair roots of the boy ...
